# Pixeldoro

> Pixeldoro is a free pomodoro timer inside a cozy pixel art world where you study next to real people.

Pixeldoro is made by Pixeldoro Labs (Sergei Andrei Postnov, IE). It's free, with no ads and no subscription. An optional one-time Supporter pack adds 25% more coins every session, a profile badge, premium skins, furniture, backgrounds, rooms and a bonus quest.

It runs on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux, in the browser and as a Discord Activity. It's available in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish and Indonesian. Ratings: 5.0 on Google Play, 4.9 on the App Store, 4.9 on the Mac App Store.

## What it does

- Pomodoro timer: 25/5, 45/15 and 15/3 presets, custom lengths, a stopwatch of up to 8 hours, a real alarm when a session ends and a reminder when the break is over.
- Study with real people: every character in the world is a real person in a focus session, showing their timer, pomodoro count and what they're working on. There's no camera and no microphone. It works as online body doubling or a live "study with me".
- Rooms: the countryside, downtown, a bar, the shop and HQ, each with its own crowd, plus servers (lobbies) to switch between.
- Friends: see which friends are online, where they are and what they're focusing on, and visit each other's houses.
- Lofi radio: six built-in lofi and chill stations, with rain and fog.
- Focus tags and stats: label each session (exams, coding, reading) and see focus hours split by tag.
- Rewards: every session earns coins to spend in the shop on furniture, rooms, outfits and pets.
- Quests: story, daily and weekly quests, a streak quest and a weekly community challenge.
- Sync: progress syncs across devices when signed in with an email code or Discord.

Not included yet: app or website blocking, and a to-do list.

Pixeldoro Mini is a separate, minimal app for iPhone and Android: just a timer, pixel art backgrounds, lofi music and stats.
